name: CAS Cable
old_description: High speed internet and cable to keep everyone connected, plus local customer service you’ll love.
about:
CAS Cable operates from Parkersburg, West Virginia, where it has provided telecommunications services since 1977. The family-owned company traces its origins to that year, when the owner purchased a small antenna television system in Washington, West Virginia, selling over-the-air channels to customers within sight of the tower. The founder built the cable infrastructure himself, physically connecting a headend near the antenna tower to homes with coaxial cable.

Today the company delivers a triple-play bundle of high-speed internet, cable television, and digital phone service across Wood, Jackson, and Kanawha counties in West Virginia and parts of Washington County, Ohio. Residential plans range from 500 Mbps download with a 1.5 TB data allowance to a 3 Gbps tier offering 3.5 TB. Business customers receive dedicated internet and phone solutions, and the firm also streams local community events through its cable platform. Subscribers may lease a modem from CAS Cable or supply their own approved device, and a customer dashboard called MyCAS centralizes account management.

The service targets both households and businesses in the greater Parkersburg–Vienna area, Jackson County, the Charleston/Kanawha County region, and across the river into southern Ohio. Customers include remote workers, families streaming video, and commercial clients who rely on reliable voice and data connectivity for daily operations.

CAS Cable emphasizes its local, family-owned character as a differentiator: a live person answers every support call, technicians live in the communities they serve, and the company avoids automated phone menus. Its stated core values center on keeping services online around the clock, treating every interaction as a personal one, and restoring service quickly after storms or equipment failures.
